segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Colorado's AI rules could change chatbot age checks
segments.narration: Colorado's new AI rules could change chatbot age checks. They're not final.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Colorado adopted its ADMT and chatbot rules
segments.narration: Adopted November nineteenth, they still need an Attorney General opinion. Final comes twenty days after publication.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Age estimates, AI disclosure, review of denials
segments.narration: Chatbots must estimate age and say they're AI. One report says ID alone won't do, and denials need a thirty-day explanation.

segments.title: Your chatbots may need changes
segments.narration: Your chatbots may need changes. The catch: nothing's final, and key claims are unconfirmed.
